name: Bonus 4: Mari's Predicament
source:
Mari is in serious trouble. A perverted, egomaniacal superior has the hots for her good friend Dr. Kunieda. She now has a hard decision to make in order to help her friend deflect his twisted advances.

[From [url=https://www.azdev.org/download]the official website[/url]]
translation:
马里遇到了严重的麻烦。一位变态、自大的上级对她的好朋友国枝博士产生了好感。她现在需要做出一个艰难的决定，以帮助她的朋友扭转他扭曲的追求。

[来自[url=https://www.azdev.org/download]官方网站[/url]]
